main_conclusion.inversion_target: For a fixed rank-fifteen core K, enumerate positive even binary bridges C and cyclic anti-isometric graph embeddings into A_K; retain only overlattices whose complete norm-two coset profile is empty.
main_conclusion.missing_exact_experiment: Enumerate and automorphism-deduplicate admissible bridge replacements beyond the 42 observed edges, then certify connectivity or genus completeness by a spinor-genus or mass calculation.
main_conclusion.negative: No same-NS corridor click is detected by a change of finite discriminant form; a pure overlattice extension cannot annihilate an existing root.
main_conclusion.positive: Four exact layers recur: primitive-U change, rank-two cyclic bridge replacement, maximal graph glue/complement, and character-primary saturation.

Kneser_reglue_candidate.definition: Replace, rather than merely enlarge, isotropic glue across a common index-p sublattice.
Kneser_reglue_candidate.finite_form_effect: Preserves the genus for ordinary p-neighbors while removing old cosets and adding new ones.
Kneser_reglue_candidate.observed_edge_identification: not the intrinsic description of the 42 observed clicks; it remains an optional decomposition and genus-connectivity move
Kneser_reglue_candidate.root_effect: Can annihilate roots and is the appropriate atomic candidate for an inverted calculus.

character_saturation.definition: Adjoin |G|-primary finite-index classes to full integral rational-isotypic lattices, or record the quotient first when only rational height blocks are available.
character_saturation.finite_form_effect: For the full integral C2 isotypic lattices the saturation quotient is killed by two; a visible or rational-block quotient requires a separate proof. Any actual index changes determinant by its square.
character_saturation.integrality_warning: A finite quotient between rational Mordell-Weil height blocks is not by itself a Nikulin discriminant-form glue subgroup.
character_saturation.root_effect: An overlattice alone cannot remove roots already present.

maximal_graph_glue.definition: Glue primitive orthogonal lattices K,W along the graph of an anti-isometry q_K to -q_W.
maximal_graph_glue.finite_form_effect: The maximal isotropic graph kills the full discriminant and produces a unimodular ambient.
maximal_graph_glue.root_effect: The complement changes when the embedding or anti-isometry changes; roots must be tested in the actual complement.

primitive_U_change.definition: Replace primitive U by primitive Uprime in fixed NS and take Wprime=Uprime^perp.
primitive_U_change.finite_form_effect: None: U is unimodular, so q_Wprime is fixed by q_NS.
primitive_U_change.root_effect: Roots may leave or enter the frame because the rational orthogonal complement changes.

rank_two_cyclic_bridge_replacement.definition: For consecutive frames set K=W_old intersect W_new and C_i=K^perp in W_i; replace the rank-two bridge and its maximal cyclic graph glue over fixed K.
rank_two_cyclic_bridge_replacement.finite_form_effect: The ambient frame discriminant form stays fixed, while the bridge form and embedded cyclic graph subgroup change.
rank_two_cyclic_bridge_replacement.observed_edge_identification: proved for all 42 selected H3, Q80, NS0024, and Golay720 edges
rank_two_cyclic_bridge_replacement.root_effect: Phi(W_old) intersect Phi(W_new)=Phi(K); all removed and introduced roots are enumerated in bridge/glue cosets.

scope_boundary.Golay: Golay here means the binary-octad determinant-720 construction and its source corridor. The ternary-Golay N(12A2) foundry backend is a large frame-family census, not one of the named transition corridors, and is not silently summarized as a single tuple.
